solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Dog marks a dead body

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for marks, the old German currency
a stiff is slang for a corpse

explanation.surface: A dog leaves scratches on a corpse it has found, like something from a crime drama.
explanation.definitionFit: The mastiff is a large, powerful breed, so it is an example of a dog.

clue.text: Proposal about one tax incentive

indicators.note: about means going around, so the proposal's letters wrap the rest

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put to a meeting
I is the Roman numeral for one
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: A political proposal to bring in a tax as a spur to some behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Motivation and incentive are near-synonyms: both are a reason that drives someone to act.

clue.text: What judge has to do in total

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a judge summarises the evidence for the jury at the end of a trial
second meaning: to add up or summarise everything altogether

explanation.walkthrough: In British courts the judge's summing-up reviews the case for the jury before it retires.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to review evidence at a trial's close and to total or summarise.

clue.text: Rebel in south calling for immediate attention

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
something urgent demands to be dealt with at once

explanation.surface: An uprising in the south of a country is a pressing matter for the government.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is a person rising in revolt against authority, a synonym of a rebel.

clue.text: Initially find our relaxation in extensive woodland

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the next two words

parts.note: rest means relaxation

explanation.surface: An invitation to discover peace and unwinding among great stretches of trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A forest is a large area covered thickly with trees, a dictionary sense of extensive woodland.

clue.text: Poetic ship, British lifeboat

parts.note: Noah's ark saved its passengers from the Flood, so it is a lifeboat of sorts

explanation.surface: A literary description of a British lifeboat as a kind of sailing vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: Calling the ark a lifeboat is a playful stretch: it carried Noah and the animals through the Flood.
explanation.definitionFit: Bark, also spelt barque, is an old literary word for a sailing vessel, much used in verse.

clue.text: Waste-paper basket writer picked up

indicators.note: in a down answer, picked up means lifted upward, so the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a nib is the writing point of a pen, so it stands for a writer

explanation.surface: An author fishes a discarded page back out of the waste-paper basket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picked up' tempts you to think of a sound-alike, but in a down clue it reverses the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bin is any container for rubbish, including the small basket beside a desk for scrap paper.

clue.text: Puzzles, seeing large cup in nettles

indicators.note: in signals that the cup size is placed inside the word for nettles

parts.note: to nettle someone is to rile or annoy them
DD is a large bra cup size

explanation.surface: Someone is baffled to find a big cup sitting among stinging plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nettles' looks like the plant, but it is the verb meaning annoys.
explanation.definitionFit: Riddles are puzzling questions or enigmas, so the plural noun is a synonym of puzzles.

clue.text: Cat wants to mew, firstly

indicators.note: firstly asks for just the opening letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A cat is keen to start mewing before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A tom is a male cat, so the word names a kind of cat.

clue.text: Ears need to be adjusted for love song

indicators.note: the letters of the two words need adjusting, that is rearranging, to give the answer

explanation.surface: Your hearing must be tuned properly to appreciate a romantic ballad.
explanation.definitionFit: A serenade is a piece sung or played by a lover beneath a beloved's window, a romantic song.

clue.text: Put right what is shattering badly

indicators.note: badly suggests the word shattering is put together wrongly, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question of how to repair something that has been badly broken to pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To straighten something out is to correct or sort it, so it means to put matters right.

clue.text: Opposed to one copying smoker

parts.note: V stands for versus, meaning against or opposed to
an aper is someone who apes, that is imitates

explanation.surface: Someone against a person who mimics a smoker's habit.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaper is someone who smokes an electronic cigarette, a modern kind of smoker.

clue.text: Mark affixed to permit is bright red

indicators.note: affixed to says the first piece is joined directly onto the second

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on the skin
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: An official stamp fixed to a licence shows up in vivid crimson.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet is a brilliant red colour with a slight orange tinge.

clue.text: Share a great amount intended for audience

indicators.note: for audience says the words are to be heard, so their sound gives the answer

parts.note: a gives A; a lot is a great amount; meant means intended

explanation.surface: A big portion set aside to be handed out to the people watching.
explanation.definitionFit: An allotment is a portion allotted to someone, a synonym of share.

clue.text: Pill taken at the start on board

indicators.note: in an across answer, on means placed after, so the letter follows the board word

parts.note: a table is a board, as in bed and board or a board for meals

indicators.note: at the start asks for the opening letter of the word taken

explanation.surface: Medicine to be swallowed as soon as you get onto a ship or plane.
explanation.definitionFit: A tablet is a small compressed dose of medicine, another word for a pill.

clue.text: Fit, inhaling that French aroma

indicators.note: inhaling means taking in, so the fit word holds the French word inside

parts.note: a bout is a fit, as in a bout of coughing
que is French for that

explanation.surface: A fit of sneezing brought on by breathing in a particular French scent.
explanation.definitionFit: Bouquet is the characteristic scent of a wine or perfume, a synonym for aroma.

clue.text: It's unfortunate king goes to a part of America

parts.note: alas is the cry for something regrettable
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A regretful remark that a monarch is travelling to some region of the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Alaska is a US state, so it is a part of America.

clue.text: Go off with someone's pet, perhaps, for a doze?

definitions.text: Go off with someone's pet, perhaps
definitions.meaning: first meaning, read whimsically: to kidnap a cat, a pet given as an example
second meaning: a short light sleep

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is a joke reading, as if the word meant cat-kidnapping; the question mark flags it.
explanation.definitionFit: A catnap is a brief nap during the day, so it is a doze.

clue.text: In rebuilt patio regularly sunny for cactus

indicators.note: in says the picked letters go inside the rearranged patio letters
rebuilt means the word patio is reconstructed in a new order
regularly asks for every other letter of sunny, here the second and fourth

explanation.surface: A spiny plant thrives on a newly laid terrace that gets plenty of sun.
explanation.walkthrough: Opuntia is the prickly pear genus; 'regularly' here takes the even letters of sunny.
explanation.definitionFit: Opuntia is the genus of prickly pear cacti, so it names a kind of cactus.

clue.text: In Dynasty, women's nasal tones

definitions.note: plural in the clue, but twang is used as a mass noun for a nasal quality of voice

indicators.note: in says the women letter is placed inside the dynasty name

parts.note: the Tang was a Chinese dynasty
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: In the TV soap Dynasty, the female characters speak through their noses.
explanation.walkthrough: Dynasty looks like the American soap, but it is the Tang dynasty of China.
explanation.definitionFit: A twang is a nasal resonance in speech, typical of some regional accents.

clue.text: Seaweeds tangled up in a gale

indicators.note: tangled up means the letters of a gale are knotted into a new order

explanation.surface: Strands of seaweed get knotted together when a storm blows.
explanation.definitionFit: Seaweeds are marine algae, simple plants without true roots or leaves.

clue.text: One's going into fine distinction — bother!

indicators.note: going into means the second piece enters the first and sits inside it

parts.note: a nuance is a subtle difference
one's is I'S, written IS

explanation.surface: Someone exasperated at having to draw a subtle distinction.
explanation.walkthrough: One's gives I (one) plus S, written IS.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuisance is an annoyance, and bother is a noun meaning trouble or annoyance.

clue.text: Juice dad's knocked over

indicators.note: knocked over means upended, so in a down clue the letters are read upward

parts.note: pa's: pa is dad, plus the S

explanation.surface: Father has spilled his drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sap is the fluid that circulates in plants, a kind of juice.

clue.text: Corporation Yank backs

indicators.note: backs means goes backwards, so the tug word is read from right to left

parts.note: to yank is to tug

explanation.surface: An American supports a big company.
explanation.walkthrough: Corporation is an old humorous word for a large belly, not a company; Yank is the verb, not an American.
explanation.definitionFit: A gut is a pot belly, which jocular British usage calls a corporation.

clue.text: Finish second highest

parts.note: top means highest

explanation.surface: A runner ends up in second place, the highest of the losers.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop is to bring something to an end, a synonym of finish.

clue.text: Lightly touch seabird, for example

parts.note: to pat is to touch lightly
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: Stroke a seabird to set an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern can be a model or exemplar to copy, so it means an example.
